mapper.select: SELECT p.*,r.state_json AS financial_state_json,d.version AS original_definition_version FROM expense_prior_control p JOIN expense_report_revision r ON r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.report_id=p.report_id AND r.financial_version=p.financial_version JOIN approval_definition d ON d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.id=p.definition_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.report_id=#{reportId} AND p.round_no=#{roundNo}

SELECT s.request_id,s.before_version,s.after_version,b.state_json AS before_json,a.state_json AS after_json FROM expense_prior_control_source s JOIN finance_resource_revision b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.resource_type=s.resource_type AND b.resource_id=s.request_id AND b.version=s.before_version JOIN finance_resource_revision a ON a.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND a.resource_type=s.resource_type AND a.resource_id=s.request_id AND a.version=s.after_version WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.report_id=#{reportId} AND s.round_no=#{roundNo} ORDER BY s.request_id
